note: Hand-authored content laid over the map. Each sketch spot is placed by naming a map feature (near), a street bridge (bridge), the longest trail footbridge (trailBridge), or a fraction along the longest open creek or trail piece (creek, trail).

spots.title: Town Plaza
spots.blurb: The deodar cedar here was planted in 1923 and is still the town's holiday tree.

spots.title: The Theatre
spots.blurb: Opened in 1915 as the Strand. Its neon marquee still lights the avenue.

spots.title: Main Street Bridge
spots.blurb: Today's bridge crosses the freeway. Until the 1950s, an arched bridge of 1906 crossed the creek here.

spots.title: The Mill Annex
spots.blurb: All that remains of the four-storey flour mill James Alexander Forbes built in the 1850s.

spots.title: The Footbridge
spots.blurb: Walkers cross above Highway 17 here on their way to the mill.

spots.title: Los Gatos Creek
spots.blurb: The creek runs north from here toward Vasona Lake.

spots.title: Creek Trail
spots.blurb: The Los Gatos Creek Trail follows the water north to Vasona Lake.

spots.title: The Library
spots.blurb: The library stands where the town's 1908 high school once stood.

spots.title: Town Hall
spots.blurb: Los Gatos Town Hall, in the civic centre off East Main Street.

spots.title: The Museum
spots.blurb: The town's museum of art and local history.

spots.title: Flame of Liberty
spots.blurb: A memorial flame in the heart of town.
